claim_boundary: This classifies coherent affine multiplier symmetry only. It does not decide any of the nine open fixed families, unrestricted LP(333), or H(668).
legendre_pair_consequence: The two sequences may be shifted independently without changing their PAFs. Therefore a common coherent multiplier-with-translation subgroup for an LP(333) normalizes to a fixed common multiplier subgroup. The 21 source IMPOSSIBLE families extend to coherent affine translations; the nine source OPEN families remain open.

theorem: For every subgroup H of (Z/333Z)^*, every coherent affine H-action whose invariant +/-1 sequence can have row sum +/-1 is a coboundary, hence a cyclic shift conjugates it to fixed multiplication by H.
